guidance.summary: Annual capex guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion
guidance.quote: in line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion - ₹ 16 billion annually through to FY 2030.

guidance.summary: Export contribution target of greater than 10%
guidance.quote: We remain on track toward our greater than 10% export contribution goal.

guidance.summary: FMEG EBITDA margin target of 8% to 10% by FY 2030
guidance.quote: progressing towards the 8%-10% EBITDA target by FY 2030.

guidance.summary: Dividend payout target of crossing 30% by FY 2030
guidance.quote: in line with our goal of crossing 30% dividend payout by FY 2030.

guidance.summary: Annual capex spending guidance of 1,200 crores to 1,600 crores
guidance.quote: and we'll perhaps do somewhere between ₹ 1,200 crores to ₹ 1,600 crores for the year.
